# Button

Triggers an action. Use one high-emphasis button (Default, Glow or Gradient) per view; Link for inline navigation. Loading keeps the label and disables interaction.

## Import

```tsx
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Button } from "@cesuain/ui/button";
```

## API

Exports: `Button`, `buttonVariants`.

Types: `ButtonProps`, `ButtonVariantProps`.

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

## Figma

Component properties in the Figma library:

- Label (text)
- Leading icon (boolean)
- Trailing icon (boolean)
- Icon (instance swap)
- Variant: Default | Glow | Gradient | Secondary | Outline | Ghost | Destructive | Link
- Size: md | sm | lg
- State: Default | Hover | Disabled | Focus | Loading

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `button.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
